object.content:
Last night I planned on writing up a blog post on my Closet Door Lightswitch, but realized there was one feature I wanted to impliment but haven't done so yet --  a shut down timer. I wanted the light to automatically shut off after a set amount of time if the doors were left open. After working on it for most of the night, it still didn't work as I had planned. I spent too much time programming the MSP430 chip in the launchpad and then switching it back to the circuit. I will have to make an in-circuit programmer/debugger next time I work on that project because it will make my life so much easier. With only two pins to solder, I should have done it earlier.

My code: https://github.com/dwaq/Closet-Door-Lightswitch/blob/automatic-shut-off/Closet-Door-Lightswitch.c
